beats.caption: Local deterministic replay: constructed cases and simulated nodes. No live model or production writes.
beats.zh: 本地确定性回放：使用构造案例与模拟节点，不调用在线模型，不写入生产环境。
beats.voice: This local replay uses constructed cases and simulated nodes. It makes no live model calls or production writes.

beats.caption: Case triage combines a classification, an RMA recommendation, evidence citations, and an action plan.
beats.zh: 案例分诊给出故障分类、RMA 建议、证据引用与行动计划。
beats.voice: Case triage gives a classification, an RMA recommendation, evidence citations, and an action plan.

beats.caption: On-call patrol reads six simulated nodes. This recording replays Firestore responses locally.
beats.zh: 值班巡检读取六个模拟节点。本次录制在本地回放 Firestore 响应。
beats.voice: On-call patrol reads six simulated nodes. This recording replays the Firestore responses locally.

beats.caption: Run patrol starts the workflow. This static browser app has no resident monitoring process.
beats.zh: 点击 Run patrol 启动流程。静态浏览器应用没有常驻监控进程。
beats.voice: Run patrol starts the workflow. This static browser app has no resident monitoring process.

beats.caption: The replay drives the actual tools. This patrol made 17 tool calls, counted from the UI.
beats.zh: 回放驱动真实工具代码。本次巡检有 17 次工具调用，数量取自界面。
beats.voice: The replay drives the actual tools. This patrol made 17 tool calls, counted from the interface.

beats.caption: scan_cluster and inspect_node return node evidence. Case mode exposes 6 tools; patrol exposes all 10.
beats.zh: scan_cluster 与 inspect_node 返回节点证据。案例模式有 6 个工具，巡检模式有 10 个。
beats.voice: Scan cluster and inspect node return node evidence. Case mode has six tools; patrol has all ten.

beats.caption: Two nodes, the same fault code: Xid 94.
beats.zh: 两个节点，报的是同一个故障码：Xid 94。
beats.voice: These two nodes reported the same fault code, Xid 94.

beats.caption: lyg2103: one occurrence in 30 days, correctable ECC flat. Verdict hardware_watch, so no RMA.
beats.zh: lyg2103：30 天只出现 1 次，可纠正 ECC 平稳。判定 hardware_watch，不报修。
beats.voice: lyg2103 fired once in thirty days, and its correctable ECC is flat. Verdict hardware watch. No RMA.

beats.caption: lyg2112: 53 occurrences in 30 days, correctable ECC at 118 and rising. Recommend hardware escalation.
beats.zh: lyg2112：30 天累计 53 次，可纠正 ECC 已到 118 且仍在上升。建议报修。
beats.voice: lyg2112 fired 53 times in thirty days. Correctable ECC is at 118 and rising. Recommend hardware escalation.

beats.caption: The same Xid can require different responses. The history and telemetry support the decision.
beats.zh: 同一个 Xid 可能需要不同处置。历史记录与遥测共同支持判断。
beats.voice: The same Xid can need different responses. History and telemetry support the decision.

beats.caption: Two local simulated cordons block new jobs while running jobs continue. Both appear in the operation log.
beats.zh: 两次本地模拟 cordon 阻止新任务进入，现有任务继续运行。操作日志记录了两次处置。
beats.voice: Two local simulated cordons block new jobs while running jobs continue. Both appear in the operation log.

beats.caption: Verification checks the returned simulated state. Here, all storage responses come from the local replay.
beats.zh: 验证检查返回的模拟状态。本次所有存储响应均来自本地回放。
beats.voice: Verification checks the returned simulated state. Here, every storage response comes from the local replay.

beats.caption: Raw simulated node state uses the Firestore REST document format. This is a local replay response.

beats.voice: Raw simulated node state uses the Firestore REST document format. This is a local replay response.

beats.caption: The local replay state survives a page reload. lyg2112 remains cordoned.

beats.voice: The local replay state survives a page reload. lyg2112 remains cordoned.

beats.caption: The catalog assigns risk: 6 low, 5 medium, 3 high. Medium and high risk require human approval.
beats.zh: 目录定义风险：6 个低风险、5 个中风险、3 个高风险。中高风险必须由人工审批。
beats.voice: The catalog assigns risk: six low, five medium, three high. Medium and high risk require human approval.

beats.caption: On 14 constructed cases, the F8 rule baseline gets classification and RMA jointly correct on 11/14.
beats.zh: 在 14 个构造案例中，F8 规则基线的分类与 RMA 联合正确率为 11/14。
beats.voice: On fourteen constructed cases, the F8 rule baseline gets classification and the RMA decision jointly correct on eleven.

beats.caption: The three misses involve a secondary event, a rising error trend, and a code deadlock. This is not production accuracy.
beats.zh: 三个失误涉及次生事件、错误上升趋势与代码死锁。该分数不代表生产准确率。
beats.voice: The three misses involve a secondary event, a rising error trend, and a code deadlock. This is not production accuracy.

beats.caption: Run rule baseline is local and reproducible. This replay does not claim an aggregate AI score.
beats.zh: Run rule baseline 可在本地复现。本次回放不宣称汇总 AI 得分。
beats.voice: The rule baseline is local and reproducible. This replay does not claim an aggregate AI score.

beats.caption: REA is not included in this build. Production use needs telemetry, scheduler integration, access controls, and review.
beats.zh: 本版本不包含 REA。生产应用还需要遥测、调度集成、访问控制与人工审核。
beats.voice: REA is not included in this build. Production use needs telemetry, scheduler integration, access controls, and human review.
